'''ISB-120''' was a series of [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ISB-120 series was produced by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
